summary.text: MELHUS SPORT AS is a private limited company registered in Melhus, founded 2021-10-11. MELHUS SPORT AS operates in retail trade of leisure equipment, games and toys, and runs sports stores, along with other activities naturally connected to this, including buying and selling other companies within the same segment. It was previously named NYE MELHUS SPORT AS until 2022-04-23. Its main industry code is 47.631: retail sale of sports equipment. The register shows 8 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 13 521 047 NOK and the annual result was -958 869 NOK; operating income was down from 16 763 200 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 798 684 NOK in 2024 to -958 869 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 3 428 285 NOK in 2024 to 2 469 416 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is opplevsport.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The registered employee count went from 10 on 2025-12-13 to 8 on 2026-08-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
